description: Backend Cloud Run platform request-log 5xx counter. Route identity is the bounded tuple (method, route, route_action); unknown paths have empty route and are excluded from the route alert. The route catalogue covers the incident and chronic routes from 2026-10-02.
filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.project_id="based-hardware" AND resource.labels.service_name="backend" AND logName="projects/based-hardware/logs/run.googleapis.com%2Frequests" AND httpRequest.status >= 500 AND httpRequest.status < 600

labels.description: Bounded HTTP method; combined with route and route_action for route identity.
Finite static path catalogue. /v1/conversations with action reprocess denotes /v1/conversations/{id}/reprocess. Unknown paths are empty.
/v1/conversations for the parameterised reprocess route; empty otherwise.
reprocess for the parameterised conversation reprocess route; empty otherwise. IDs and queries are never labels.
5 for all matching request logs; all 5xx status codes count together.
